notes: system files may be overwritten on scaffold upgrade; user files are never touched. package.json is user-owned because users add their own deps. The vendored Trivial SDK (src/lib/trivial-{auth,data}.ts) and the build-injected src/trivial.config.json are SYSTEM-owned (more specific than the src/lib/** user glob) — the platform manages them. The SDK is dormant until the maker declares src/trivial.manifest.json and publishes (the retired src/pages/dynamic-demo.tsx referenced demo tables that no longer exist for new projects; older projects keep their user-owned copy).
